# Internal hosts and identifiers that check-oss-hygiene.mjs tolerates for now.
#
# Format: <path> <token> # PR <n>: <reason>
# - <token> is the whole host or identifier as the check reports it
#   (case-insensitive). One entry covers every occurrence in that file.
# - Every entry must name the PR that removes it.
# - An entry that no longer matches anything fails the check, so the PR that
#   removes a token (or moves its file) must delete or update the entry.
# Do not add entries for new code: use example.com or a placeholder instead.
